name: krishisetu
description: KrishiSetu: Full-Stack Digital Farmer Procurement and Collection Platform (SHI26032)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server run db:generate
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start:all: concurrently -k -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan,green" "npm --prefix server run start" "npm --prefix client run preview"
